text: Chicago Public Schools ordered Marjane Satrapi's The Complete Persepolis: Volumes 1 and 2 removed from its curriculum for 7th graders. The book was also removed from middle school libraries in Wilson County.
meta_description: The Complete Persepolis by Marjane Satrapi: removed from the Chicago Public Schools 7th-grade curriculum and from Wilson County middle school libraries.
changes: Two removals separated by actor; author added from pack.
